versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Attribution & Content Credit Tracker skill.

- Automates monitoring and detection of unauthorized content republication across the web.
- Generates legal enforcement documents (DMCA, cease-and-desist letters) with customizable templates.
- Manages canonical tags and resolves conflicts to protect SEO credit for original content.
- Builds automated "As Seen In" galleries from verified citations and backlinks.
- Tracks enforcement actions and compiles compliance reporting for legal and marketing teams.
- Integrates with platforms including WordPress, Slack, Google Search Console, and DMCA.com.
